question.problem: Which of the following is equivalent to $7x≡1\,(\text{mod}\,20)?$
question.worked_solution:
The scalar multiplication properties of congruences state that for $k\in Z,$ we have the following:

- $a≡b\,(\text{mod}\,n)\,⟹\,ka≡kb\,(\text{mod}\,n)$

- $a≡b\,(\text{mod}\,n)\,⟹\,ka≡kb\,(\text{mod}\,kn)$

The modulus equals $20$ in all statements, which suggests we'll need to use the first property.

Notice that the coefficient of $x$ is $7,$ and $3\cdot 7=21$ is one larger than the modulus. Therefore, we can reduce the coefficient of $x$ to unity as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}7x & ≡1\, & (\text{mod}\,20) \\ 3\cdot 7x & ≡3\cdot 1\, & (\text{mod}\,20) \\ 21x & ≡3\, & (\text{mod}\,20) \\ x+20x & ≡3\, & (\text{mod}\,20) \\ x+0x & ≡3\, & (\text{mod}\,20) \\ x & ≡3\, & (\text{mod}\,20)\end{aligned}
$$
